footnote_text: This amendment is filed to correct the transaction code for the acquisition of RSUs on June 17, 2026. The original Form 4 incorrectly reported the transaction under Code S (Open-Market Sale) and is hereby amended to report the transaction under Code A (Grant/Award). || The shares represent unvested restricted stock units (RSUs), with the RSUs vesting in full on the earlier of (i) the one-year anniversary of the date of grant or (ii) the date of the Issuer's next annual meeting of stockholders held after the date of grant. || Includes shares to be issued in connection with the vesting of one or more RSUs.
